maddeler.e:
يجتمع (form VIII)
# يَجْتَمِعُ (yajtamiʕu) /jad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
# يُجْتَمَعُ (yujtamaʕu) /jud͡ʒ.ta.ma.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
# يَجْتَمِعَ (yajtamiʕa) /jad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَمَعَ (ijtamaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
